digest.component_or_area: Event store write seam (secret content screening)
propositions: The store accepts event bodies containing live credentials (API keys, PAT tokens, service accounts) without validation, enabling a single credential-bearing comment to wedge the entire shared tickets branch behind GitHub push protection.

No content screening exists in the write path; event_append._validate_event checks only envelope shape and event_type membership, not the data field; four separate writers bypass append_event including the reconciler's untrusted Jira-sourced inbound translate.
A deterministic pure secret screen must be enforced at _seam.finalize_event (the single function all write paths route through) to refuse events matching high-confidence credential patterns.
Refusal is loud and reversible with an audited --allow-secret-pattern override, structurally preventing secret leakage into exception messages, logs, stderr, or on-disk events.

False positives from prose describing credentials (truncated placeholders, regex literals, PEM banner enumerations) must not fire when the actual secret is full-length and high-entropy, verified by fixed-width pattern windows and line-anchoring.
